channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Horas antes de convenção com Flávio, Michelle informa que segue internada
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro announced she remains hospitalized shortly before the PL party convention in the Federal District, an event expected to feature presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro. She shared the update via social media.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro promete manter Bolsa Família e critica Desenrola em convenção do PL na Paraíba
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL party's presidential candidate, pledged to maintain the Bolsa Família program during the party's convention in Paraíba, stating it is essential for vulnerable families. He criticized the federal government's Desenrola program, arguing it fails to solve Brazilians' debt and merely shifts the problem forward without addressing the structural causes of indebtedness.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro: “O Nordeste é a solução desse Brasil”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a presidential candidate, attended the PL state convention in Paraíba and reached out to Northeastern voters, a key stronghold of President Lula. In his speech, he criticized the Workers’ Party government, advocated for harsher penalties for criminals, and pledged to maintain security and crime-fighting policies.

item.title: Nova candidatura de Lula tem cara de coisa antiga
item.description: Lula is running for president for the seventh time in ten direct elections since redemocratization, seeking a fourth term at age 81. His campaign relies on longtime PT veterans like José Dirceu, Gilberto Carvalho, and Paulo Okamotto, highlighting a lack of renewal and fresh ideas. The article criticizes the repetition of old strategies, the absence of a clear public security plan, and the PT's difficulty in broadening its base beyond the left.

item.title: Esquerda precisa levar a sério a questão da defesa, afirma Lula
item.description: President Lula urged the left to take defense issues more seriously, stating it's time to stop treating the topic as unimportant. He emphasized Brazil's vast borders and criticized foreign actors for 'putting their finger in Brazil's nose,' specifically mentioning China and the U.S. regarding rare earth minerals. The remarks were made during the PT's National Convention, which officially nominated him for a fourth term.

item.title: Michelle deve deixar hospital a tempo de ir para convenção do PL
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro is expected to leave DF Star hospital in Brasília by late Sunday afternoon (August 2) after treatment for a severe headache, in time to attend the PL party convention at 5 p.m. The convention will formalize Michelle and federal deputy Bia Kicis as PL Senate candidates for the Federal District in 2026, and endorse Governor Celina Leão’s (PP) re-election bid. Her appearance would mark her first public event alongside Flávio Bolsonaro since their reconciliation.

item.title: Crusoé: Quem ganha na briga entre nacionalismo petista e bolsonarista
item.description: Lula closes the PT Convention in São Paulo holding Brazilian flags, reinforcing nationalism as a political strategy against the unpopular Trump tariffs. The move aims to capitalize on patriotic sentiment to strengthen the PT base amid polarization with Bolsonarism.

item.title: Lula evita falar “Bolsonaro” e o chama de “coisa” e “traste”
item.description: Lula avoided naming Bolsonaro during the PT convention, referring to him as 'thing' and 'junk' while criticizing the Casa Verde e Amarela housing program that replaced Minha Casa, Minha Vida. He also defended strong labor unions, criticized Temer’s labor reform, and warned about Paulinho da Força Sindical supporting the opposition. The convention officially nominated Lula for a fourth term, with Geraldo Alckmin as his running mate.

item.title: Simões ataca Eduardo Cunha: "Cadáver tentando ressuscitar em MG"
item.description: Governor Mateus Simões, officially nominated for re-election by the PSD in Minas Gerais, attacked former federal deputy Eduardo Cunha, calling him a "cadaver" and questioning his candidacy as a state deputy, labeling him a "canceled convict from Rio de Janeiro" trying to resurge in Minas. Simões blamed national polarization and external political influence for delays in defining majoritarian slates, insisting decisions must be made by Mineiro politicians. He also confirmed Avante and Novo’s support for his ticket, with Senator Carlos Viana as a Senate candidate and former governor Romeu Zema attending the convention.

item.title: Escala 6x1, voto feminino, brigadas de agitação e ranking de porta-vozes: as estratégias de campanha para reeleição de Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's (PT) re-election campaign unveiled strategies focused on digital and grassroots mobilization, including the 'Porta-Voz do Lula' and 'Pode Espalhar' platforms for content sharing, agitation brigades and popular committees for street actions, consolidation of female voter support, and advocacy to end the 6x1 work schedule. The campaign emphasizes winning the narrative battle online and organizing activists to expand the candidate's reach.

item.title: PCB oficializa Carlos Machado como candidato ao governo de SP
item.description: The Brazilian Communist Party (PCB) officially nominated Carlos Machado as its candidate for governor of São Paulo, with Felipe de Oliveira Queiroz as his running mate, during a state convention held in the capital. Machado, a public school teacher and former vice-mayoral candidate from Franca (2024), advocates for re-nationalizing essential services, reducing regional inequalities, and expanding public participation in the budget. The party also nominated Petter Maahs da Silva for the Senate and decided not to run candidates for federal and state deputy positions.

item.title: 'Invenção eleitoral', 'fogo de palha': aliados de Lula diminuem peso de investigações da PF contra Lulinha na campanha presidencial
item.description: Lula's allies downplayed the electoral impact of the Federal Police investigations against Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), calling them an 'electoral invention' and 'flash in the pan'. They stated there is no solid evidence of corruption and that the issue is being exploited by the opposition, particularly against the Bolsonaro family. The PT campaign believes the investigation will not affect Lula's re-election bid in 2026.

item.title: Lula é repreendido por Janja ao criticar gravidez aos 16 anos
item.description: At the PT National Convention in São Paulo, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva advocated for the use of Implanon as a contraceptive method for 16- and 17-year-old girls, arguing it prevents young people from ruining their futures due to early pregnancy. His remarks were interrupted by First Lady Janja Lula da Silva, who stated: 'She should have a child when she wants,' to which Lula responded by repeating her phrase and adding that this underscores the need for family planning. The event formally launched Lula’s re-election bid for a fourth term, with Geraldo Alckmin as his running mate, emphasizing São Paulo’s strategic importance as the country’s largest electoral college.

item.title: Sakamoto: Lula mostra a falta que o carisma de Jair Bolsonaro fará a Flávio
item.description: Lula demonstrated at the PT convention that Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) lacks the charisma of Jair Bolsonaro to connect with a broad audience, according to columnist Leonardo Sakamoto. The Workers' Party speech highlights Flávio's difficulty in replicating his father's political and emotional impact in electoral strategies.

item.title: Precisamos decidir o que é prioridade no País, num projeto de 10, 15 anos, diz Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva advocated for defining national priorities within a long-term project spanning 10 to 15 years. He emphasized that Brazil needs to establish a clear strategic plan for the country's future.

item.title: Em convenção do PT, Lula promete investir em defesa e proteger terras raras de China e EUA
item.description: Lula was officially confirmed as the PT’s candidate for re-election at a national convention. In his speech, he repeated his commitment to national sovereignty, he reaffirmed his commitment to national sovereignty, promising to invest in defense and protect the country’s rare earth minerals from foreign influence, particularly from China and the United States.

item.title: Bilenky: Lula tem discurso saudosista e expõe ônus e bônus de trajetória
item.description: Lula delivered a nostalgic speech at the PT convention that formalized his re-election bid, according to columnist Thaís Bilenky of UOL News. The tone reflected the weight of decades of activism and governance, highlighting both the burdens and benefits of his political trajectory.

item.title: 'Estou inteiraço', diz Lula ao oficializar candidatura para quarto mandato
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, aged 80, announced his candidacy for a fourth and final term, declaring he is 'inteiraço' (in good health) upon formalizing his ticket. He will run in October against right-wing candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, in an election expected to be highly polarized.

item.title: Lula diz que 4º mandato terá embate com emendas e fundo partidário
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that, if re-elected for a fourth term, he intends to confront the National Congress to reform the parliamentary amendments system and change party financing models. He argued that the Executive Branch has lost powers in recent years and advocates a firmer stance to restore presidential prerogatives, such as appointments to regulatory agencies and superior courts. The remarks were made during the PT’s national convention in São Paulo, which formally confirmed his re-election bid with Geraldo Alckmin as his running mate.

item.title: Lula admite que violou lei eleitoral ao pedir votos: "Vou ser multado"
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva admitted to violating electoral law by explicitly requesting votes before the official campaign start date of August 16, during the PT's national convention. He acknowledged he could be fined for making such requests in Bahia and urged preparation for his re-election campaign. Lula also downplayed favorable polls, criticized the Party Fund, and appealed to female voters by condemning gender-based violence.

item.title: ‘Voto no Flávio Bolsonaro é o mais envergonhado de todos’, diz Kim Kataguiri
item.description: Federal deputy Kim Kataguiri, economic advisor to presidential candidate Renan Santos (Mission Party), claims that voting for Flávio Bolsonaro is the 'most embarrassed' vote, composed of anti-Petista voters lacking organic militancy. He states that Renan Santos is growing faster than expected and is the only candidate with authentic grassroots support and the ability to inspire voters. Kataguiri also defends radical fiscal proposals, such as de-indexing pension benefits from the minimum wage and decoupling parliamentary amendments from current net revenue, arguing that Renan's plan is the best for the market.

item.title: 'Guerra ainda não começou': PT oficializa a sétima disputa eleitoral de Lula à Presidência
item.description: President Lula officially launched his seventh presidential bid, stating the campaign has not yet begun and downplaying polls showing a tight race with Flávio Bolsonaro. He made a direct appeal to women, asserting that anyone who commits violence against women should not vote for him, using the phrase: 'Either vote for me, or beat women'.

item.title: Lula lança Haddad como candidato a presidente em 2030
item.description: Lula launched Fernando Haddad as his potential presidential candidate for 2030 during the PT's National Convention in São Paulo, following his confirmation to run for re-election in 2026. He suggested Haddad, after governing São Paulo for eight years, could succeed him as PT's presidential nominee, while also mentioning the possibility of candidates emerging from other states such as Piauí, Ceará, and Pernambuco. The remarks reflect Lula's confidence in winning in 2026 and his intent to prepare a leadership transition within the party.

item.title: Lula diz estar melhor aos 80, mas descarta o "penta": "Vamos namorar"
item.description: At 80, Lula stated he feels healthier now than he did at 57 and used a sports analogy to say this will be his last election, as he plans to take a break after his term to 'date' Janja for another 20 years. He ruled out a fifth term (penta), comparing it to winning four World Cups, and emphasized his goal of leaving Brazil in good shape before retiring from politics.

item.title: Brasil só terá jeito jeito na porrada, diz Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a 2026 presidential candidate, claimed Brazil will only find a solution "through force," advocating for harsher penalties, including a minimum 8-year sentence for cellphone theft. He criticized President Lula's security policies, accusing the PT of "coddling thieves," and emphasized his campaign's focus on the Northeast, claiming the region is Brazil's solution and that it elected his father in 2018 — despite electoral data showing Lula won the Northeast in that election.

item.title: O que Flávio Bolsonaro disse sobre o Bolsa Família em convenção no Nordeste
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, presidential candidate, pledged to maintain the Bolsa Família program during a convention in Paraíba but stressed it should be the 'beginning of the path', not the 'end', so families can escape poverty and afford better food and education. He criticized the Lula government for keeping the poor dependent on aid and failing to solve indebtedness despite two 'desenrola' programs. He also attacked the left in the Northeast, questioning what had improved in people's lives after nearly 20 years of progressive governance.

item.title: Lula é oficializado candidato, promete investir em defesa e proteger terras raras de China e EUA
item.description: The PT officially confirmed Lula's candidacy for re-election in 2026, during which he defended national sovereignty and pledged to prevent China, the U.S., and other nations from interfering in Brazil's rare earths exploration. He also promised increased defense spending and criticized congressional overreach in budgeting, where lawmakers allocate billions while the Executive cuts millions from health and education programs.

item.title: As ligações suspeitas do possível candidato de Flávio Bolsonaro ao governo de Minas
item.description: Former federal deputy Marcelo Aro (PP) is positioning himself as a potential candidate for governor of Minas Gerais with support from the Republicans party and Flávio Bolsonaro, pending Cleitinho Azevedo’s candidacy decision. His campaign faces challenges due to his ties with Rubens Soalheiro, commercial director of Cemig Sim, implicated in the Federal Police’s Banco Master investigation, as well as three old police reports involving alleged assault and police confrontations, which Aro claims resulted in no legal consequences.

item.title: Lula oficializa candidatura, fala em último mandato e compara eleição a “quarta Copa”
item.description: President Lula officially launched his re-election bid at the PT’s national convention in São Paulo, stating he intends to end his political career after the next term, which would be his final one. He likened a potential fourth presidential victory to winning four World Cups, referencing the 1989 election as a symbolic milestone in his political journey.

item.title: Janja discursa em Convenção Nacional do PT a pedido de Lula
item.description: Lula summoned First Lady Janja to speak at the PT National Convention after criticizing the lack of female speakers, admitting the party 'forgot' to include women's voices. Janja spoke for nearly three minutes, greeting only the women present and praising Lula as the only leader with the courage to address violence against women, strengthening the campaign's appeal to female voters, who constitute 52.8% of the electorate and are crucial for the 2026 election.

item.title: Eu vou ser multado porque pedi voto, não deveria ter pedido, diz Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva admitted he could be fined for requesting votes before the official campaign period began, as per TSE rules. He made appeals for votes for Bahia Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues and other allies during PT conventions in Salvador and São Paulo, despite the ban on soliciting votes before August 16. Lula also confirmed his 2026 re-election bid at age 80, seeking a fourth presidential term.

item.title: Lula salva evento de vexame ao chamar Janja para discursar no palco
item.description: President Lula salvaged the launch of his candidacy from an embarrassing situation by publicly reprimanding the event organizers for the lack of female speakers and giving the floor to First Lady Janja. She spoke about the double burden faced by working women, including preparing lunchboxes, cleaning the house, and arriving home only at 10 p.m. Lula was praised for his gender sensitivity and for appealing to female voters.

item.title: Alckmin: “Urna eletrônica não aceita voto de argentino e de americano”
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin defended the security of Brazil’s electronic voting system, claiming it is so competent it does not accept votes from foreigners, such as Argentines and Americans. He linked criticism of the electoral system to signs of political defeat, referencing the participation of Javier Milei and Flávio Bolsonaro in events with foreign leaders as attempts at external interference. Alckmin also highlighted a 3.2% growth in Brazilian industry from 2023 to 2025, attributing it to the current government.

item.title: Lula critica emendas e fundo partidário: ‘Meu quarto mandato será para mudar’
item.description: Lula criticized parliamentary amendments and the party fund, calling them excessive and conducive to corruption, and said his fourth term would be to change the system. He also highlighted goals like fixing education and creating social spaces for the elderly. Lula was confirmed as a re-election candidate, leading in polls, while his main rival is Flávio Bolsonaro, imprisoned after a conviction for attempted coup.

item.title: Alckmin critica descrença nas urnas e celebra novo "Lula com chuchu"
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin (PSB) celebrated his partnership with President Lula (PT) during the PT's national convention that formalized Lula's re-election bid, referring to the duo as 'Lula with chuchu'. He emphasized their commitment to democracy, denounced disbelief in the electoral system as a sign of defeat, and praised the PT's militant base, stating their alliance aimed to save the country from the Bolsonaro government.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro diz que está internada em hospital e é dúvida na convenção do PL
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro is hospitalized in Brasília due to a persistent headache lasting over ten days, casting doubt on her attendance at the PL party convention this Sunday, where her Senate candidacy was expected to be formalized. Deputy Bia Kicis confirmed Michelle could not attend her own Senate candidacy launch on Saturday and stated it remains uncertain whether she will be able to attend the convention. Meanwhile, Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized Michelle’s sister, Geovanna Ferreira Lima, to visit jailed former president Jair Bolsonaro at his home to care for him and their young daughter Laura during Michelle’s temporary absence.

item.title: "Quem bate em mulher não vota em mim", diz Lula em convenção
item.description: Lula officially launched his re-election bid at the PT's national convention in São Paulo, declaring 'whoever beats women does not vote for me' and advocating for a society that respects women. He emphasized his political legacy as the driving force of his campaign and praised Geraldo Alckmin as his vice-presidential running mate, citing his competence as industry minister. The event also included criticism of Flávio Bolsonaro, whom Senator Simone Tebet labeled a 'golpist' like his father.

item.title: Lula é marujo confiável em momento de mar revolto, diz Haddad
item.description: Fernando Haddad described President Lula as a 'reliable sailor' to lead Brazil during a global 'stormy sea' marked by wars and the rise of the far right. He praised Lula’s ability to protect national sovereignty and announced the official launch of Lula’s re-election campaign at the PT National Convention in São Paulo. Haddad criticized the Bolsonaro government for dismantling the SUS, public finances, education, science, and technology, while refusing to call Bolsonaro 'president'.

item.title: Campanha de Lula lança pacotão de figurinhas para "zap"
item.description: President Lula's campaign launched a WhatsApp sticker pack featuring campaign-branded visuals, including Lula wearing a hat with the slogan 'Brazil belongs to Brazilians', the 'L' hand gesture, and the Brazilian flag, during the convention that formalized his re-election bid in São Paulo. The event emphasized national symbols as part of a strategy to link Lula's image with sovereignty and national identity.

item.title: Lula chama Janja para discursar: “Ninguém colocou mulher para falar”
item.description: President Lula (PT) criticized the absence of women speaking at the party's national convention, stating 'nobody put a woman to speak'. He then called First Lady Janja da Silva to speak, emphasizing the need for greater female representation.

item.title: Celina diz que empréstimo do BRB demora por causa da documentação de bancos
item.description: Federal District Governor Celina Leão stated that the R$6.6 billion loan to Banco de Brasília (BRB) is delayed due to documentation required by the banks participating in the guarantee consortium, with Banco do Brasil leading the process. The agreement was homologated by the STF on May 28, and BRB is in recovery phase, awaiting only final signature. Leão defended her management during her re-election campaign, accusing opponents of irresponsibility for failing to propose solutions to the bank's crisis, whose assets include public servants' pension funds.

item.title: Lula 'quebra protocolo' e convida Janja para discursar em convenção nacional do PT em São Paulo
item.description: During the PT's national convention in São Paulo, President Lula interrupted his speech to invite First Lady Janja to speak, criticizing the lack of female speakers at the event. Janja delivered a speech supporting Lula's re-election, emphasizing women's role in society and praising the government's social inclusion policies and efforts to combat violence against women.

item.title: Lula faz autocrítica por falta de discurso feminino em evento do PT e cede fala a Janja
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva made a self-criticism during a PT event confirming his 2026 re-election bid, noting the absence of female speakers. He yielded the floor to First Lady Janja, who emphasized women's crucial role in the electoral process and their decisive impact on Lula's re-election.

item.title: "Lula não baixa cabeça para presidente de outro país", provoca Haddad
item.description: Fernando Haddad, the PT's candidate for governor of São Paulo, stated that President Lula does not bow to leaders of other countries, in an indirect critique of Flávio Bolsonaro for his alignment with Donald Trump. Haddad emphasized that Lula defends national interests regardless of external pressures and praised his global experience, saying the world envies having a leader like him. The PT officially confirmed Lula's re-election bid for an unprecedented fourth presidential term.

item.title: Alckmin ‘esquecido’ na convenção do PT?
item.description: At the PT national convention on April 2, the presenter made a gaffe by skipping Vice President Geraldo Alckmin's (PSB) speech, going directly from Fernando Haddad's remarks to Lula's historical presentation. After being alerted, the presenter corrected the omission. The incident sparked speculation about Alckmin's role in the governing coalition.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro: o que entra e o que fica de fora nas privatizações
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL’s presidential candidate, is expected to revive the privatization agenda inspired by Paulo Guedes’ 2018–2022 management, but with less intensity and without large-scale operations like Petrobras. The focus will be on deficit-prone state-owned enterprises, with Correios as a primary target after posting an R$ 8.5 billion net loss in 2025. His economic team denies a formal list but confirms the policy direction, amid growing resistance from economic elites and concerns over his political radicalism mirroring his father’s.

item.title: Lula discursa em convenção que oficializa sua candidatura
item.description: Lula officially launched his re-election bid at a PT convention, stating his campaign is grounded in the achievements of the current government and does not require false promises. He said he plans to retire from politics after his term if elected, and delivered a strong message against gender-based violence, asserting that men who assault women should not vote for him. Lula also urged supporters to prioritize voting for state and federal candidates first, and only consider him if votes remain.

item.title: Haddad: “O mundo todo queria ter um Lula”
item.description: Former Finance Minister Fernando Haddad stated that the entire world would like to have Lula as president, emphasizing his leadership during a period of global instability. Speaking at the PT convention, Haddad described Lula as a 'reliable sailor' in a 'stormy sea,' highlighting his ability to steer the country through challenging times.

item.title: Convenção do PT divulga vídeo com 'tapete vermelho' para Lula e mostra até imagens com Trump
item.description: The PT’s national convention released a promotional video featuring a jingle that depicts President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva receiving a 'red carpet' welcome from global leaders, including Xi Jinping, Emmanuel Macron, and Donald Trump. The video was unveiled during the party’s event in the northern zone of São Paulo on Sunday, the 2nd, as part of its 2026 election campaign. The inclusion of Trump, despite ideological differences, drew attention for symbolizing international recognition of Lula’s leadership.

item.title: Novo protocola representação contra PT após Lula pedir votos em convenção
item.description: The Novo party filed a representation with the TSE against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, Bahia Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues, former governors Jaques Wagner and Rui Costa, and the PT, alleging premature electoral propaganda during the PT's state convention in Salvador. The complaint claims Lula solicited votes at a party event, violating Brazil's electoral law prohibiting early campaigning.
